idea: The one habit that fixed my mornings
text:
How many mornings start without a plan? [pause] I know the answer. This one habit changed everything. [smile]

Here's the thing: I set a clear three-minute routine the moment I wake up. [look at camera] It’s sorting my thoughts and setting boundaries. [pause] I review my goals right after breakfast. [pause] That simple sequence cut decision fatigue. [pause]
title: The one habit that fixed my mornings
